items.title: Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters Registered 40+ Domains Mimicking Zendesk Environments
items.description: A sophisticated, complex new cyber offensive has emerged from the “Scattered Lapsus$ Hunters,” a threat collective that has aggressively shifted toward exploiting supply-chain vulnerabilities. This latest campaign targets Zendesk, a critical customer support platform, effectively turning a trusted business tool into a launchpad for corporate spying.
